432:t_012:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「What a shameful love triangle! No offense to $$セツコ$$, but take a lesson from $$アルト$$ and try coming at it with a little purer heart!」

432:t_012:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit jerking $$セツコ$$ around for your own selfish convenience.」

432:t_012:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm used to being cursed at. It doesn't bother me.」

432:t_012:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Besides, I'm not the only one who came to save her.」

432:t_013:0.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! And $$クロノ$$'s unit, too!」

432:t_013:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've come to help you, $n.」

432:t_013:4.en:
$n
「I... We'll fight with our own strength.」

432:t_013:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're grateful for all the cooperation $$クロノ$$ has given us so far. But your actions are shrouded in far too much mystery.」

432:t_013:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you consider us your collaborators, it is about time you told us the truth, including the doctrine of $$クロノ$$.」

432:t_013:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There is no need.」

432:t_013:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Knowing the truth would mean nothing to you. What you must do is overthrow the $$サイデリアル$$ and the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives who serve under them.」

432:t_013:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We're not your grunts, you know.」

432:t_013:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If I have offended you, allow me to correct myself.」

432:t_013:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even so, you don't seem to intend to tell us everything.」

432:t_013:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I told you. It would mean nothing.」

432:t_013:17.en:
$$レド$$
「I've met him only a few times, but I can't understand what he's saying.」

432:t_013:18.en:
$$レド$$
「What that man is trying to do is no different from the rule of $$ストライカー#robot$$!」

432:t_013:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is on our side...」

432:t_013:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-$$ノノ$$ thought it was strange too! Why do you trust him so much!?」

432:t_013:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I agree with you! He might not be a bad guy, but something's still off!」

432:t_013:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's only because you haven't known $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ for long...」

432:t_013:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So this is what you meant by 'love is blind.'」

432:t_013:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Before we knew it, we'd come to take it for granted that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was right.」

432:t_013:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He really was on our side. He helped us out of tight spots and guided us.」

432:t_013:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That kept up, and before we knew it, we'd forgotten that faint sense that something was off.」

432:t_013:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's only natural. When everyone is anxious, people want to entrust themselves to a great power that shows them what is right.」

432:t_013:30.en:
$n
「And you're saying that power is you?」

432:t_013:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I always do what is right. Fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ is one such thing.」

432:t_014:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch! Is it a disadvantage to fight $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ in this situation!?」

432:t_015:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It can't be helped... Now that the boss has pulled back, let us abandon the base.」

432:t_016:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are falling back.」

432:t_016:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Will this liberate $$翠の地球$$, then?」

432:t_016:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Good work, $c. Now, next is... $$蒼の地球$$.」

432:t_016:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You would push my hand away?」

432:t_016:5.en:
$n
「...You've helped me many times, and guided me many times.」

432:t_016:7.en:
$n
「But I have to keep fighting with my own strength...!」

432:t_016:8.en:
$n
「Please, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! If you call me someone who shares your ideals, tell me everything!」

432:t_016:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I told you, there is no need.」

432:t_017:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Why...? Let me ask you in return. Why do you have doubts about me?」

432:t_017:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To all units. It seems $c cannot be our comrades.」

432:t_018:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We have no intention of fighting!」

432:t_018:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「All units, begin the attack.」

432:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! $$ブルー$$!」

432:t_019:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「All we did was raise a little doubt, and you're going way too far!」

432:t_019:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Do you know something!?」

432:t_019:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$... Do as you wish. There are four $$スフィア$$s here.」

432:t_019:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Watch out, $n! He's got the $$偽りの黒羊$$ $$スフィア$$!」

432:t_019:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「That $$スフィア$$ should be a bad match for your $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

432:t_019:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No need to worry. $$アサキム$$ cannot master a $$スフィア$$.」

432:t_019:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even if he can use the power of a $$スフィア$$, he will never become a $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

432:t_019:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Trying to throw us off with those kind-sounding words!?」

432:t_019:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no such intention. I simply plan to be $n's opponent myself.」

432:t_019:14.en:
$n
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I don't want to fight you!」

432:t_019:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's a shame, $n. I did not want this outcome either.」

432:t_020:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll cover you! Right now, think about protecting yourself!」

432:t_021:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「What do we do, $$ブライト$$!?」

432:t_021:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have no choice! Return fire!」

432:t_021:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our target is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll stop him and find out what he's really after!」
